title: Sample 1_I025
characteristics_ch1: cell line source: iPSC line 1 | cell type: iPSC-cardiomyocytes (iPSC-CMs) | culture period: Day 30
treatment_protocol_ch1: iPSC-CMs were cultured until day 30, as well as long-term until day 90 and day 200.
growth_protocol_ch1: iPSCs were differentiated into iPSC-cardiomyocytes (iPSC-CMs) using a monolayer small molecule-based method.
extract_protocol_ch1: RNA was extracted using a miRNeasy Mini Kit, and collected total RNA was used for RNA-sequencing. | AmpliSeq sequencing data was performed using the AmpliSeq plugin available for Ion Torrent™ sequencing platforms
data_processing: hg19 AmpliSeq transcriptome ERCC v1 was used as a reference genome for alignment of raw sequencing reads. | Read count normalization was performed using the regularized logarithm (rlog) method provided in DESeq2 (PMID: 25516281). | Differentially expressed genes were identified using DESeq2, and p-values were adjusted for multiple testing using the procedure of Benjamini and Hochberg. | Genome_build: hg19 AmpliSeq transcriptome | Supplementary_files_format_and_content: Ion Suite
